## History

Susan is a classmate who joins a story club founded by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/di.md). Along with other members like Jane and [Ruby](../character/ruby-gillis.md), she participates in the group created to cultivate their imaginations through writing romantic story plots.
